references.text: The same principle of eating meat like gazelle and deer, where both unclean and clean people may eat it
Mentions the deer and gazelle among the clean animals that may be eaten
Repeats the instruction to eat meat within the gates, such as gazelle and deer, with unclean and clean together
Isaac asks Esau to hunt game, showing that hunting was permitted and blessed
Concerns blessing the Lord for the good land He has given, parallel to the Lord's blessing mentioned in the verse
The Lord's blessing as the basis for what one has, the same theme of God's blessing
Elaborates on the instruction to slaughter and eat meat within the gates when living far from the sanctuary
